execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Resolve asin cast and integer-range portability
priorities.reason: The passing Clang corpus does not establish signed-subtraction safety or equivalence on LP64 and LLP64.
priorities.next_action: Trace the caller invariants bounding phi/ph for the adopted binary64 asin gap predicate; prove one named range or isolate the exact missing premise. No unchanged corpus replay.
priorities.deliverable: Tested optional unsigned predicate and explicit range/ABI note; next a coarse all-input range lemma under stated floating-point assumptions.
priorities.acceptance: Tests alone do not prove absence of UB. Explicitly distinguish source undefined behavior, compiler miscompilation and unsupported ABI execution.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on an unqualified ABI, unresolved range premise, source change or cap; do not label unsupported execution a failure.
priorities.dependency: Pinned asin source; qualified toolchains and a small reproducible test harness.
priorities.change: Restored after scoped near-one log stopping certificate; no new asin proof claimed.

priorities.title: Track cosine proof or census changes
priorities.reason: Published cosine PDF sign correction verified. Source synchronization and generation evidence remain open.
priorities.next_action: Recheck only on changed TeX or new generation evidence.
priorities.deliverable: Identify the matching public TeX revision when available, or reconcile new census evidence.
priorities.acceptance: No whole-function proof or unreachability claim from corpus tests; keep supplied-data verification separate from exhaustive regeneration.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on changed source or missing premise; do not repeat unchanged campaigns.
priorities.dependency: Pinned cosine source/proof and subsequent maintainer feedback; no broad coverage or exp campaign.
priorities.change: Sign bookkeeping is present in the published PDF. Public proof master still returns the earlier TeX. See November 9 receipt for exact artifact identities.

priorities.title: Exact bivariate regressions: move beyond the two hypot midpoint families
priorities.reason: Both sides of the restricted hypot midpoint now have small certified examples. Preserve the missing archive work and try a different pow hypothesis.
priorities.next_action: Design an exact comparator for positive normal pow(x,3/2) by comparing x cubed with squared dyadic rounding boundaries. First certify a bounded sample and controls; no general pow runner qualification or altered exponent sweep.
priorities.deliverable: One bounded exact pow reference sample, or a precise feasibility limit. Keep angular/import checkpoints separate.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop on a failed control or cap. Recheck archive availability at the next checkpoint, report the blocker once and continue independent infrastructure work; do not silently drop the requested import.
priorities.dependency: Exact rational input decoding and integer comparisons; separately qualify any future pow library adapter. Archived research unavailable.
priorities.change: Both exact midpoint families now appear in upstream hypot.wc at 185b7dec. All 32 ordered pickup rows match. Preserve earlier numerical runs with their dates.
